mission: New-sources plan step S0 (owner approved the plan 2026-10-19 00:34Z, diagnostic only): add two reviewed read-only db-diagnostic files. source-bytes-by-source reports bytes stored per source per UTC day (RAW, price observations, collection attempts) and a 48 h MB/day figure per source, for the Dorasuta 1.5 MB/day cap (N6) and storage checks that overlap Yuyu-Tei batches. new-source-coverage reports priced prints by rarity, variant and number of shop sources over 24 h and 7 days, plus latest Market Index coverage. Register both in ops-readonly. Staging only; PSA10 not read; no source, collector, setting, price, identity, mapping, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: Two SELECT/WITH-only diagnostics (9 statements) over sources, raw_snapshots, raw_snapshot_dictionaries, price_observations, source_collection_attempts, card_prints, canonical_cards, source_card_mappings and market_index_snapshots, run only in the existing default_transaction_read_only db-diagnostic session with its statement timeout. Raw asks counted are yuyutei sell and snkrdunk floor only (no buy, sold or PSA10). No write, no source request.
Adds new-source-coverage and source-bytes-by-source to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic (two new read-only SQL files)

dependencies: ops runbooks from PR #139, #143, #150, #155, #157, #158; diagnostics from PR #156, #166 and #174 (unchanged); new-sources plan on branch plan/new-sources (d0bd629)
impact.deployment_impact: Two read-only diagnostics and their workflow choice entries. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes; snkrdunk and yuyutei collectors untouched.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the two diagnostics and their workflow choices. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run of a new file that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or returns anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic run per new file, dispatched one at a time, completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries rows or names them in rows_omitted.
